final: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity FROM equipment_avg), above_avg AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, e.avg_humidity - o.avg_humidity AS difference FROM equipment_avg AS e CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE o.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL AND e.avg_humidity > o.avg_humidity), above_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity FROM above_avg) SELECT a.equipref, a.avg_humidity, a.difference, a.avg_humidity - g.avg_humidity FROM above_avg AS a CROSS JOIN above_group_avg AS g WHERE g.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.avg_humidity - g.avg_humidity DESC LIMIT 10
